title: Build a website
blurb: Create a multi-page website from a template or from scratch.

steps.title: Choose Websites
steps.body: Click **Websites**. A website has multiple pages and a menu, like Home, About, Services and Contact.

steps.title: Pick how to start
steps.body: Choose **From templates** for a ready-made site, **Build with AI** to have it drafted for you, or **From blank**. Name it, like **Your Business Website**, then click **Create**.
steps.tip: Templates save hours. You can change every word, image and colour.

steps.title: Edit and publish
steps.body: Open a page to edit it. Click any text or image to change it, and drag in new sections from the left. Click **Save**, then **Preview** to check it on mobile.

steps.title: Connect your domain
steps.body: To make it live on your own address, open **Domain Settings** and add your domain. We'll show you the record to add at your domain provider.
